body.message:
Hi , hope you’re doing well.

Our current lease in Business Bay will be ending in about 9 or 10 days, and we’re starting to look for a new place. We were hoping you could assist us in finding a larger unit—ideally a 2-bedroom—or any more spacious option within a reasonable budget.

Given the current market conditions, we believe there might be more suitable and possibly more affordable options available in the same area.

Please let us know if you have any listings or suggestions that could match what we’re looking for. We’d really appreciate your help again.

Thank you!
